note: Peak resident memory (MB) of the process of each kind of layer of F2a/F2b on BRA, the largest country, measured in the cold round of 2026-11-03 (interim/BRA/*/layers.json; COMMANDS 88/89; docs/_audit/memory_budget_88.md). F3 (land_eligibility) is not a layer process: it runs by stripes of rows since COMMAND 91 and peaks at 1,438 MB on BRA (see f3_phase).

phase_caps.note: Cap per phase of the pipeline (COMMAND 131, core/memory_cap.py): cap_mb = ceil(1.25 x the peak measured on BRA, the largest country) rounded up to a multiple of 64 MB; a phase may go up to 25% above it while the free memory covers the excess plus over_cap_reserve_mb (the excess is written to the manifest as peak_over_cap); the hard limit is cap_mb x 1.25. A phase with no entry here has `cap_mb` of the file (1,536 MB). peak_rss_mb is the larger of the manifest's `peak_rss_mb` and `cold_peak_rss_mb` of the phase in outputs/BRA/manifest.json on measured_on; the peaks of technical_potential and potential_maps are those of COMMAND 129 (BRA 1,579 and 1,676, IND 1,018 and 1,207, PRT 338 and 657). The phase robustness_analysis (F7) is the peak of COMMAND 185 on BRA (3,174 MB, caps off, max_batch_gb 0.5); lcoe_modeling, sample_size_convergence, external_validation, lcoe_maps and robustness_maps are the BRA peaks of COMMANDS 179 to 188A (external_validation measured with the caps off); results_synthesis is the BRA peak of COMMANDS 190B and 190C (caps off, 2,814 MB; the first run stopped at the hard limit of 1,920 MB); exploratory_analysis is the BRA peak of COMMAND 211 (caps off, 2,081 MB; results_synthesis peaked at 2,149 MB with the exploratory outputs, under its cap); the other phases of F6 to F8 and the support phases have the default.

external_validation.detail: BRA, COMMAND 188A, final run through main.py with the 1,920 MB hard limit lifted by the author's decision (2,782 MB in the first run with the caps off); the potential tables are read whole, so a lighter read would lower it

results_synthesis.detail: BRA, COMMAND 190B, run through main.py with GEOFREA_MEMORY_CAPS=0 (V179c): the first run with the default cap stopped at the hard limit (1,926 MB, in the T-O3 figure); the cap is ceil(1.25 x 2,814) rounded up to a multiple of 64 MB

exploratory_analysis.detail: BRA, COMMAND 211, run through main.py with GEOFREA_MEMORY_CAPS=0 (V179c), 128 s; the potential, nominal LCOE and P90 tables of the 15 core members and the reference are read whole for the F7 set; the cap is ceil(1.25 x 2,081) rounded up to a multiple of 64 MB
